purpose: Freeze coordinate-to-node-aliasing estimands before the Macdonald tracking shapefiles are available to mina.

standardized_input.colony_id: Named biological colony identity supplied by the source dataset.
standardized_input.season: Breeding-season label supplied or deterministically recovered from source files; no demographic inference.
standardized_input.multiple_rows_per_date: Distinct mapped colony groups/subgroups; if group_id is absent, every geometry point on the date is treated as one mapped group.

geometry.date_centroid: Arithmetic centroid of all mapped group points on a colony-date after projection.
geometry.seasonal_anchor: Date centroid on the earliest observation date of each colony-season.
geometry.interannual_displacement: Euclidean distance between seasonal anchors in successive observed seasons for the same named colony.
geometry.within_season_detection_distance: Minimum Euclidean distance from the seasonal anchor to any mapped group on a later observation date.

estimands.interannual_false_turnover: For each radius r, fraction of successive-season named-colony anchor transitions with displacement > r.
estimands.within_season_false_absence: For each radius r, fraction of post-anchor observation dates for which every mapped group lies > r from the seasonal anchor.
estimands.identity_preserving_radii: Empirical q50, q90 and q95 of interannual anchor displacement and within-season minimum-group distance.
estimands.no_primary_radius: No single radius is selected as biologically true; the aliasing curve is the primary representation.

exclusions.missing_successive_season_transition: Do not interpolate across a missing season for the primary consecutive-season transition count; report gaps separately.
exclusions.multiple_groups: A node remains detected on a date if at least one mapped group is within radius r.

inference.reason: Three intensively tracked colonies are not independent support for a continent-wide frequency law.
inference.bootstrap: Not primary; uncertainty may later be described by colony-level leave-one-colony-out summaries.

boundaries: Named-colony identity is not demographic closure.
False turnover means disagreement between fixed-coordinate and source-provided named identity, not proof that individual birds are the same.
Do not alter radius set after observing tracks.
Do not replace minimum-group detection with date centroid because that would count a split colony as absent when one group remains inside the node.
Do not infer causes of movement in this analysis.
